notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hey guys, and welcome back to another devlog! This time we’ll be highlighting developments from April.

April was primarily spent making sure everything was ready for the demo launch (if you haven’t tried it yet, why not?!), as well as the speedrun contest. Find out more about those here in this post:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1696630/announcements/detail/3696935994332995870

This devlog will be short and sweet, but let's get into it!

[h2]Gameplay Developments[/h2]

Small tweaks were made to the movement, trying to make the game feel as good as possible. Adjustments were also made to the length and difficulty of levels - they should be easy to complete, but tricky to grab those top times to earn medals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/55eebddc5759b4326cffec8817197acf712b44f6.png[/img]

Gamepad support has been added, so you now choose your weapon of choice! The controls have also been added into level 1, so you can go back there for a refresher!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/95714dac5be9ab1679f2050a1cde03e5a0ed63ae.png[/img]

Finally, a flashing lights warning has been added in at the beginning of the game, just to make sure everyone understands RunMan Turbo is filled with crazy color chaos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/59909bd3b4a5b65611d138b03df2bc169d1d004d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Merch[/h2]

RunMan Turbo t-shirts are available! Find them here:

https://phlswag.com/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/d458d9b05a84ce1915590a445b1ebcbefe9a41cf.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/874a32468b71c650cee26736b01d6edb0076117a.jpg[/img]


That’s all for April’s update! If you haven’t already, play the demo and leave a review (we’ll be super grateful!)

See you in the next one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/831678aca83d6c7eb6142491186bae54cb6d8fb9.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thanks for tuning back in for another Devlog! This time we’re taking a look at the progress made over March. A lot of work has been put into tidying up Act 1 for the demo - you’ll be able to play it soon, I swear! 

[b]A new map design, gameplay alterations and special animations! Keep reading to find out more![/b]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

[olist]
[*] The final level has been reworked, primarily around the wall bouncing mechanic. In previous builds, the wall bouncing felt clunky and slowed down a run, however it’s now been changed so your momentum isn’t affected.
[*] Colliding with a cannon now sends you upwards with your momentum, rather than hitting you backwards and cancelling your speed. 
[*] The max speed of RunMan has been uncapped, which has allowed all levels to be slightly longer, as well as increase the skill ceiling.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/463b55782b2b9bf2bc79dca842463ad83e4fae20.gif[/img]

[h1]Art Updates[/h1]

The map has gone through some changes. The order of the levels has been changed, some of the levels have been renamed, new graphics have been added and the medals you collect now show on the left hand side. See the old vs new map below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/df279b341051351110f516ffa7742144389e1f42.png[/img]

New animations have been added for various scenarios. Accelerating, slowing down, hitting something, as well as birds smacking you about if you get too high. These have all been added for better readability of the gameplay, to really understand what’s happening with RunMan and to let you, the player, get the fastest time possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/104c9cb303e637b8a42cbd4bde4544176f2dbe10.gif[/img]

[h1]Other cool things[/h1]

Story aspects have been added in! A short intro and outro have been added in to give some context to the game, as well as show what to expect within the full game release. ⇩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/0d6f10bce0223649ae506fa0ddb50199369c2e26.png[/img]

A fullscreen button, toggle mute music button and toggle mute SFX button have been added in. ⇩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/d50e6e97c5d59ad593fd307e133438c3492520a3.png[/img]

The UI now has your target time and best time when you’re running levels. ⇩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/4fb591c5514149a94977a479707f3a3fbab4b2e8.png[/img]

New graphics have been added in when you start and finish a level, as well as RunMan popping up to tell you when you get a new personal best, and a medal floating into the screen when you hit a target time! ⇩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/55eebddc5759b4326cffec8817197acf712b44f6.png[/img]

Our next update will (fingers crossed!) include details of a demo release date, so make sure you follow the game and wishlist RunMan Turbo if you haven’t already! 

See you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, and welcome to the first of the monthly devlogs for RunMan Turbo! This one will be short and sweet, as a lot of February’s updates were included in the previous update - go check it out if you haven’t already:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1696630/view/3671032690255858372

In this post we’ll be giving a small development update, sharing some upcoming events you might see us in as well as getting your feedback on what you’d like to see over the coming months. Let's get into it!

[h2]Development Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/15d790e671d5989f89d8550a496e717e9eef64fb.png[/img]

Levels 1-5 within Bliss Valley are close to being finished. These levels have been revisited a few times to make sure they look and play as intended, as well as fit in with the rest of the game. Some internal playtesting has been done that’s opened eyes to potential issues. RunMan Turbo has terrain changes and obstacles you can react to, and it’s important that you [i]can[/i] react. We don’t want the old school sonic problem!

RunMan has faces now! He’s becoming more realistic by the day. Check out those pearly whites below:
https://twitter.com/TomSennett/status/1631987965021810688?s=20

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/ecf4a3c603d07fd3b40eca8f993efcd7c961849b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Events[/h2]

We can now confirm we’ll be a part of two events in the near future!

The first is the Game Development World Championship 2022, a global competition for all types of game developers - hobbyists to studios! It’s a great celebration of all things game dev, and will be taking place in Spring of this year. RunMan Turbo is through the first stage, and you can find the page here!
https://thegdwc.com/games/35cd7ce7-0497-441d-a82d-40c6637d4e32

We’ve also been accepted to compete in A MAZE 2023, taking place in May. A MAZE celebrates all kinds of different digital media related to the gaming space, as well as providing talks and workshops to help educate and inspire video game creators. Find RunMan Turbo’s page here.
https://2023.amaze-berlin.de/submissions/runman-turbo/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/b855ba3a4ad30bbd22332d1b465a084428e5bc77.gif[/img]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

We’d love to know what you’d like to see from us in the future! Would you like an FAQ? Submit questions for an AMA? A development roadmap? If you like any of these suggestions or have an even better idea, let us know in the comments or talk to us on Discord!
Discord invite: https://discord.gg/97pBk85sSM

If you read this far, thank you! Remember to give the post a like, and we can’t wait to see you in next month's devlog!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/b308a8d1e8daf6ebcee7112daf9326c4ba4557ee.png[/img]

notes.title: RunMan Turbo Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In this post we’ll be giving an update on the development of RunMan Turbo so far, what’s being worked on currently and plans for the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/f734deb4abd9e67f98ce70e6eb1df6be46b707d6.png[/img]

[h2]Past:[/h2]

The return of RunMan was announced back in September, and there was a great response from both old fans and new - thank you! Since then, the main focus has been on designing Act 1: Bliss Valley and nailing the story. There was also a playtest for the game and we launched a Teaser Trailer! 

The development of RunMan Turbo is staying very faithful to the Tom Sennett Games universe, so making sure the bright colours and big personality translate into the gameplay and level design has been a priority. So far, the focus has been on getting Act 1 to a good place. After some experimentation and changes within the development of Act 1, the rest of the game will follow more smoothly with all the main decisions made.

We collected some valuable feedback from a playtest we ran on an early build. Letting you all see a glimpse into the game was really helpful and fun to see what everyone’s initial thoughts were! Join the Discord if you want to take part in future playtests! Link at the bottom of the post.

The launch of RunMan Turbo’s Teaser Trailer happened at the end of 2022 - you can watch it below! There’s still a lot of game to show, so stay tuned over the coming months!

[previewyoutube=EHLvS67jzbU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Present:[/h2]

Currently, development is focused around content for the demo. For you to get your hands on the game is the main priority, as you’ll be able to get a feel for what the game is really like as well as share any thoughts on it! The demo will be centered around Act 1, but I won’t say any more as we don’t want to ruin the surprise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007422/b855ba3a4ad30bbd22332d1b465a084428e5bc77.gif[/img]

[h2]Future:[/h2]

RunMan Turbo has big plans for the future! We’ll have content over on social media, monthly Devlogs here on Steam, as well as hopefully appearing in some other places online - make sure you follow us to stay updated! 
In terms of development, RunMan Turbo has a few more acts, unlockables and super-secret content to make it into the game so it’s full steam ahead to make everything as good as it can be. 

Thank you all so much for the support so far, we can’t wait to share more with you!

Stay updated and follow us everywhere!
